title: The Escape Game at Westfield UTC in San Diego
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our San Diego location is at Westfield UTC, close to a vibrant selection of dining and retail options. This is the perfect spot to escape with friends or family before then grabbing a bite to eat! Nearby food and drink spots include Eureka, Blue Ocean Sushi and Grill, Quin West Noodle, and Bazille.
